_comment: These rows are NOT created here. CodeGen mints one EntityRelationship per foreign key, so all
three Forms parent -> child relationships already exist by the time this directory is pushed;
what this directory does is fill in ONE column on them -- `RelatedRecordCollection`, the JSON
that turns a plain relationship into a typed, writable child collection on the parent entity.
autoCreateMissingRecords is FALSE, deliberately overriding the repo-root default. Every record
here resolves its primary key with @lookup against Entity + RelatedEntity, and the CodeGen row
it targets is re-minted with a NEW ID on every rebuild-db -- which is exactly why the lookup is
by name rather than by a hardcoded UUID. If a lookup ever fails to resolve, the correct outcome
is a LOUD FAILURE. With auto-create on, the push would instead insert a SECOND, half-populated
EntityRelationship beside CodeGen's, and the collection would appear to work while the
duplicate quietly broke the next codegen run. That is not hypothetical here: #69 exists because
a duplicated `Forms -> Form Screens` row made regeneration emit the same array property twice
and forms-server stopped compiling on every machine that ran codegen for five weeks.
The pull side creates nothing and appends nothing. `RelatedRecordCollection IS NOT NULL` is a
property, not an ownership predicate -- MJ core ships a dozen rows matching it and every
co-installed Open App adds more, so an appending pull would rake other people's declarations
into this file and the next release seed would ship them.
